decisions.reason: GA4 remains the current analytics standard and central to the firm's analytics offering, so the firm keeps it and sees little reason to drop.
Universal Analytics is permanently discontinued by Google, so poor results cannot be attributed to temporary causes and the firm drops it despite sunk costs.
The retail system interface plugin supports integration services and weak results still appear temporary, so the firm keeps it.
The shop relaunch SEO support service has high visibility with its own page and is central to the announced SEO direction, so the firm keeps it.
The SEO workshops are new, have their own page, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm keeps them.
